exposure: continuous insulin treatment for diabetes mellitus (Type 1 and Type 2)
efforts to maintain normoglycemia before and during pregnancy
outcome: successful delivery of newborns without major events
cohort: This study focuses on four Japanese women, recipients of the Lilly Insulin 50-Year Award, who had diabetes (Type 1 or Type 2) and successful deliveries approximately 40-50 years ago, having received continuous diabetes treatment before, during, and after pregnancy.
finding: Maintaining normoglycemia before and during pregnancy in women with diabetes can lead to successful delivery of newborns without major events, even if some long-term diabetic complications may arise later in life.
